name: カラープロファイルメタデータ
description: Analyzes ICC color profile data, color space declarations, bit depth, and rendering intent metadata to detect AI generation patterns. Professional cameras embed complex color profiles, while AI tools typically output basic sRGB.
algorithm: ICC/色空間メタデータアナライザー
mechanism:
The color profile analysis examines multiple metadata layers:

1. **ICC Profile Detection**: Identifies the embedded ICC color profile type. Professional cameras use Adobe RGB, ProPhoto RGB, or Display P3 profiles, while AI-generated images almost universally use basic sRGB IEC61966-2.1.

2. **Bit Depth Analysis**: Checks color depth metadata. RAW files from cameras use 12-bit, 14-bit, or 16-bit color depth. AI outputs are invariably 8-bit per channel.

3. **Color Space Consistency**: Cross-validates color space declarations across EXIF, ICC, and XMP metadata. Inconsistencies suggest metadata fabrication.

4. **Rendering Intent Check**: Professional workflows preserve rendering intent (perceptual, relative colorimetric). AI tools rarely set this metadata correctly.
parameters:
Camera profiles: Adobe RGB, ProPhoto RGB, Display P3, DCI-P3
AI-typical: sRGB IEC61966-2.1
Bit depths: 8-bit (standard/AI), 12/14/16-bit (professional RAW)
Rendering intents: perceptual, relative colorimetric, saturation, absolute colorimetric
accuracy: Medium - 70-80%. Strong indicator when advanced color profiles (Adobe RGB, ProPhoto) are present. Less reliable for consumer cameras that default to sRGB.
useCase: Supporting evidence in metadata analysis pipeline. Particularly useful for identifying professional photography (which uses wide-gamut profiles) vs AI-generated content (which uses sRGB). Effective as part of a multi-signal approach.
strengths:
• プロのカラープロファイルはAIツールが複製困難
• ビット深度分析でカメラとAIを明確に区別
• 偽陽性率が低い
• 高速で非破壊の分析
• RAW由来の画像識別に有用
limitations:
• 多くの一般カメラもsRGBをデフォルト使用
• AIツールがカスタムICCプロファイルを埋め込む可能性
• JPEG変換でプロファイル情報が失われる
• SNSプラットフォームがICCプロファイルを削除
• sRGBカメラとAI出力を区別できない
